verdict.rationale: An email service like Fastmail could plausibly ship an official CLI, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only the JMAP API, API tokens, and a jmap.io list of ecosystem implementations, including a "Terminal client". Nothing documents a Fastmail-published official CLI. The API is a developer building block, and the jmap.io list covers the open protocol's ecosystem rather than a first-party Fastmail tool, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
